summary: The lab facility has added several new advanced instruments such as the Thermo Scientific Spectra Ultra FEGTEM, Thermo Scientific Talos F200i FEGTEM, JEOL IT800 SHL FEGSEM, and Tescan Clara/NewTec In-Situ FEGSEM. However, notable legacy equipment such as the FEI Tecnai G2 F20 S-TWIN TEM, FEI Tecnai G2 T20 TWIN TEM, and JEOL JSM-7001F FEGSEM have been removed, resulting in a moderate loss of historical capability and knowledge.
